task.question: What is the name of the RFdiffusion2-designed metallohydrolase reported to have catalytic efficiency several orders of magnitude higher than earlier designed metallohydrolases?
task.evidence: One design, named ZETA_1, demonstrated high catalytic efficiency several orders of magnitude higher compared to previously designed metallohydrolases.
task.page: RFdiffusion3 Now Open Source, Designs DNA Binders and Advanced Enzymes

answer:
The name of the RFdiffusion2-designed metallohydrolase reported to have catalytic efficiency several orders of magnitude higher than earlier designed metallohydrolases is ZETA_1. 

FINAL: ZETA_1
